headlines.title: Cornell sexual assault case reopened by district attorney
headlines.description: Tompkins County district attorney reopened the 2024 Cornell alleged gang rape investigation after a former student, identified as Jane Doe, filed a lawsuit against the university and others, criticizing the handling of the case.

headlines.title: 5 Arrested on Suspected Terror Plot at US Air Base in Britain
headlines.description: Five men have been arrested by U.K. police on a suspected terror plot at a key U.S. Air Base in Britain. Now an urgent investigation is underway with officials looking into whether Iran was behind the threat. NBC’s Raf Sanchez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 8 Marines Injured in Previously Unreported Iranian Attack on Hormuz
headlines.description: Three U.S. officials tell NBC News that eight American Marines were injured two weeks ago in a previously unreported Iranian attack in which a cruise missile struck their vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Common Ground: Loving your neighbor in 2026
headlines.description: TODAY's Savannah Guthrie, author of "The Meaning of Your Life" Arthur C. Brooks, PhD and pastor Michael Rudzena discuss how you can love your neighbor in 2026. Common Ground is sponsored by Comcast.

headlines.title: Ahead of rare execution, lone woman on Tennessee’s death row says ‘I am at peace’
headlines.description: Christa Pike, 50, was an accomplice in a murder she committed at 18. She would be the first woman executed by the state in over 200 years.

headlines.title: Stocks fall, bond yields surge and oil fluctuates as war keeps markets on edge
headlines.description: Stocks fell Monday alongside a jump in bond yields and erratic oil trading as geopolitical upheaval remained front and center for traders.

headlines.title: How an American teacher’s $5,000 donation helped turn a Chinese desert into a lush forest
headlines.description: Ronald Sakolsky couldn’t believe his eyes when he visited China’s Mu Us Desert for the first time in 26 years. “Seeing it with my own eyes, that was the biggest surprise,” he said.

headlines.title: Europe frets as the Kremlin pushes the limits of its hybrid warfare
headlines.description: The Kremlin is testing Europe‘s limits.

headlines.title: New data shows most women in the Marines passing toughened fitness tests for combat roles
headlines.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said he wanted women in combat roles to be held to the same physical standards as men. One year later, new numbers from the Marine Corps show most women in combat roles are meeting, or exceeding those standards. NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian reports.

headlines.title: Cornell rape accuser’s attorney says the school and law enforcement failed a young woman
headlines.description: The DA vows to pursue any additional evidence after the woman’s lawsuit prompted him to reopen the case.

headlines.title: As Republicans break with Trump, one gets a brushback: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.
